items.name: Raw Rat Meat
items.description: Rat meat. Disgusting, but edible when cooked. Barely.

items.name: Raw Trout
items.description: A fresh trout. Best cooked over a campfire.

items.name: Thistle
items.description: A common herb with mild healing properties.

items.name: Silverleaf
items.description: A shimmering silver-leaved plant with potent magical properties.

items.name: Wolf Pelt
items.description: A thick grey wolf pelt. Useful for crafting leather armor.

items.name: Wolf Fang
items.description: A sharp fang from a grey wolf.

items.name: Alpha Wolf Fang
items.description: An enormous fang from an alpha wolf. Prized by crafters.

items.name: Goblin Ear
items.description: A severed goblin ear. Proof of kill for Guild bounties.

items.name: Rat Tail
items.description: A severed rat tail. Has minor alchemical uses.

items.name: Bone
items.description: A bleached bone from a skeleton. Can be buried for Prayer experience.

items.name: Slime Gel
items.description: A glob of green slime. Key ingredient in antidotes.

items.name: Venom Sac
items.description: A toxic gland from a giant rat. Handle with care.

items.name: Leather Scraps
items.description: Scraps of leather. Can be combined into usable leather.

items.name: Empty Vial
items.description: A small glass vial for holding potions.

items.name: Bronze Arrows (10)
items.description: A bundle of ten bronze-tipped arrows.

items.name: Bronze Arrows (50)
items.description: A quiver of fifty bronze-tipped arrows.

items.name: Ancient Coin
items.description: A coin from the pre-Sundering era. Collectors pay well for these.

items.name: Stolen Goods
items.description: A sack of pilfered wares. Can be returned for a reward or sold to a fence.

items.name: Mysterious Rune
items.description: A stone tablet inscribed with glowing runes. The Arcane Council would be interested.

items.name: Aether Fragment
items.description: A tiny shard of crystallized Aether. Hums with raw magical energy.

items.name: Copper Shard
items.description: A single copper shard — the basic currency of Aethermoor.
